units.source_text: 阿雪拖着那把几乎成为她的装饰品的扫帚，向传来朝鲜妇女说话声的方向走去。

en.t: Ayuki dragged the broom that had almost become an ornament of hers and walked toward the sound of Korean women talking.

units.source_text: 她们租了温泉旅馆一间空房子住在一起。

en.t: They had rented an empty room at the hot spring inn and were living there together.

units.source_text: 这是一间农舍，连一扇隔扇、一道拉窗都没有。

en.t: It was a farmhouse, without even a single partition screen or sliding window.

units.source_text: 温泉旅馆打扫庭院的时间，朝鲜妇女都蹲在井边，洗刷早餐餐具，白裙都鼓了起来。

en.t: When it was time for the hot spring inn to sweep the courtyard, the Korean women all squatted by the well, washing the breakfast dishes, their white skirts billowing out.

units.source_text: 阿雪看见这番景象，有时也回过头来，透过古松的缝隙望望旅馆厢房的正门。

en.t: Seeing this scene, Ayuki would sometimes turn back and look through the gaps in the old pines toward the front entrance of the inn's side rooms.

units.source_text: 她忽然把扫帚靠在松树上，倏地闪开了。

en.t: Suddenly she leaned the broom against a pine tree and slipped quickly away.
